fusions.name: Loosened Strap
fusions.desc: Works a strap loose mid-blow: the strike deals 7 damage and leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Thrown Crate
fusions.desc: Hurls the nearest heavy object; it deals 26 damage to the first enemy it meets, then bursts, hitting every enemy within 3 tiles for 80% of that.

fusions.name: Untied
fusions.desc: Removes up to 3 conditions from you, and your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Second Grab
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a strike that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
